title: From GitHub to Vercel production
summary: Trace branch previews, the main-branch production build, domain assignment and live verification.

blocks.title: Vercel watches Git history and turns accepted commits into deployments
blocks.body: This repository is connected to Vercel. A branch push creates a unique preview deployment. A merge to the production branch, main, creates a production deployment. The live domain changes only after the production build succeeds and is assigned to that domain.

nodes.title: GitHub event
nodes.detail: A branch commit or main commit appears in the connected repository.

nodes.title: Vercel build
nodes.detail: Vercel installs dependencies and runs the project build for that commit.

nodes.title: Deployment
nodes.detail: The output receives an immutable deployment URL and status.

nodes.title: Environment
nodes.detail: A branch goes to Preview; main goes to Production.

nodes.title: Domain
nodes.detail: A successful production deployment becomes the version served at showmob.vercel.app.

blocks.heading: 2. Preview and production have different jobs

columns.name: Preview deployment
columns.detail: Built from a feature branch. It proves the proposed commit can run at a separate URL before main changes.

columns.name: Production deployment
columns.detail: Built from main after merge. It is the candidate attached to the public production domain.

blocks.heading: 3. Production acceptance is a readback
items: Confirm the merge commit exists on main.
Confirm the Vercel status for that exact commit is successful.
Open the canonical production domain rather than trusting only the deployment dashboard.
Visually inspect the homepage and the changed pages at desktop and 390px.
Exercise the changed interaction, then return the verified live URL.

blocks.heading: 4. Check the trigger
blocks.prompt: What normally causes this project's production deployment?
options: Merging or pushing the accepted commit to main
blocks.explanation: Vercel tracks the production branch. Branch pushes get previews; main changes get production deployments.

items.label: Write both URLs
items.detail: Record one preview URL and the canonical production domain.

items.label: Bind commit to deploy
items.detail: Copy a merge SHA and the Vercel status that names its completed deployment.

items.label: Define done
items.detail: List the pages, viewport and interaction you would visually check.

blocks.heading: Official source: Git deployments
blocks.caption: Vercel documents preview deployments for branch pushes and production deployments after changes land on the production branch.
